mapper.select: SELECT sl.*, COUNT(p.id) as pad_count FROM shelf_layer sl LEFT JOIN pad_info p ON sl.layer_code = p.shelf_layer_code GROUP BY sl.id, sl.layer_code, sl.shelf_code, sl.layer_name, sl.layer_order ORDER BY sl.shelf_code ASC, sl.layer_order ASC

SELECT sl.*, COUNT(p.id) as pad_count FROM shelf_layer sl LEFT JOIN pad_info p ON sl.layer_code = p.shelf_layer_code WHERE sl.layer_code = #{layerCode} GROUP BY sl.id, sl.layer_code, sl.shelf_code, sl.layer_name, sl.layer_order
